WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member AS mb
    JOIN major AS m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department, member_count,
           CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
)
SELECT department, member_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM department_shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
